en: AI helped us build. We chose what mattered.
zh: AI让想法落地，判断让作品成立。
en_script:
Alright, you've seen what Civilization Voyage feels like to play.
I'll now talk about how we built it, and how we plan to turn it into a business.

We used Lovable to talk through ideas. Claude helped with design, Codex with APIs, and Grok with the frontend and 3D scenes.
Then we put the pieces together on our own computer, tested them, and updated the desktop app.
You can see the result on the right.

AI helped us get there faster.
We still had to decide which stories belonged together, put them in the right order, and make the choices easy to understand.
That's the work behind the game.
Now we need to give people a reason to choose it.
Let's start with how we compare.
zh_script: 好，大家已经看到文明航程玩起来是什么样子了。接下来我讲怎么把它做出来，以及怎么把它发展成一门生意。我们用Lovable交流想法，Claude帮忙做设计，Codex处理API，Grok负责前端和3D。然后在本机把这些部分接起来，做测试，更新桌面应用。右侧就是成果。AI让我们做得更快，但哪些故事放一起、按什么顺序讲、怎样让玩家看懂选择，还是我们来决定。这是游戏背后的工作。现在还要给用户一个选择它的理由，先看我们和竞品的比较。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 接过前面同学的游戏展示，像对观众自然接话。
rehearsal.en:
Alright, you've seen what Civilization Voyage feels like to play.
I'll now talk about how we built it, and how we plan to turn it into a business.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左边制作流程，再指右侧游戏实录；工具名称之间略停。
rehearsal.en:
We used Lovable to talk through ideas. Claude helped with design, Codex with APIs, and Grok with the frontend and 3D scenes.
Then we put the pieces together on our own computer, tested them, and updated the desktop app.
You can see the result on the right.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 视线回到观众，把制作自然带到竞争关系。
rehearsal.en:
AI helped us get there faster.
We still had to decide which stories belonged together, put them in the right order, and make the choices easy to understand.
That's the work behind the game.
Now we need to give people a reason to choose it.
Let's start with how we compare.

zh: 对标竞品，明确我们的优势
en_script:
Discovery Tour is strong on historical detail.
Minecraft Education is strong on classroom tools.
What we bring is a story that stays with you as you play.

Our game covers four eras, eight routes, and twenty-four scenes, across Chinese and world histories.
The stories follow a clear order. A choice in one chapter can affect what happens in the next.
Say you share supplies with a village.
Your ship now has less. You feel that cost straight away.
Later, the village may help you. You remember why.
By the end of the voyage, you can look back and see how your choices shaped it.

That's what the line at the bottom means:
One journey. Connected choices. Consequences that follow you.
We want people to care about the story because they've played a part in it.
From there, we can build something for players, teachers, and museums.
zh_script: Discovery Tour擅长历史细节，Minecraft Education擅长课堂工具。我们带来的是一路跟着玩家走的故事。游戏有四个时代、八条航线、二十四个场景，横跨中国与世界历史。故事顺序清楚，上一章的决定会影响下一章。例如你把补给分给村庄，船上马上就少了资源，代价立刻能感受到。后来村庄可能帮助你，你也记得为什么。航程结束时，可以回头看自己的选择怎样改变了过程。底部那句话就是这个意思：一段航程，连贯选择，持续后果。希望玩家因为参与其中而关心这个故事。由此再为玩家、教师和博物馆设计产品。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 左、中两栏各讲一句，然后转向右侧文明航程。
rehearsal.en:
Discovery Tour is strong on historical detail.
Minecraft Education is strong on classroom tools.
What we bring is a story that stays with you as you play.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指右栏四时代、八航线；村庄例子像讲故事一样展开。
rehearsal.en:
Our game covers four eras, eight routes, and twenty-four scenes, across Chinese and world histories.
The stories follow a clear order. A choice in one chapter can affect what happens in the next.
Say you share supplies with a village.
Your ship now has less. You feel that cost straight away.
Later, the village may help you. You remember why.
By the end of the voyage, you can look back and see how your choices shaped it.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指底部总结，最后一句切到第三页。
rehearsal.en:
That's what the line at the bottom means:
One journey. Connected choices. Consequences that follow you.
We want people to care about the story because they've played a part in it.
From there, we can build something for players, teachers, and museums.

en: One core experience. Three reasons to pay.
zh: 共同的内容基础，三种付费理由。
en_script:
For players, the plan is simple: sixty-eight yuan for the full game.
They buy it because it looks fun. They keep playing because they want to see what happens next.
If they enjoy that first voyage, we can offer new story packs at twenty-eight yuan.
So we have to make the first game good enough that people want another one.

A teacher needs something different.
Imagine bringing this game into a history lesson. The students have played a story about a new machine. Now the teacher wants them to talk about who it helped and who paid the price.
The teacher needs a guide, a clear lesson, and help getting started.
That's our education offer: twelve thousand yuan a year per institution, with guides, two training sessions, and an agreed amount of support.
If teachers keep using it, the school has a reason to renew.

For a museum, we start with a local story.
Visitors step into that story, make a choice, and see what happens.
Our plan is sixty thousand yuan for one theme, three scenes, and two review rounds.
We can use the same game tools and research across these offers. We charge for the extra work each customer needs.
That way, each project helps us build the next one.
But we also need to know how much money is left when the work is done.
zh_script: 玩家这边很简单：68元买完整游戏。看起来有趣才会买，想知道后面怎样才会继续玩。第一段航程玩得好，再提供28元故事包。所以第一款要做到让人想玩下一款。教师的需要不同。想象把游戏带进历史课，学生已经玩过新机器的故事，接下来老师希望讨论它帮助了谁、代价由谁承担。老师需要指南、清楚的课堂安排，以及入门帮助。因此机构年费1.2万元，含指南、两次培训和约定数量的支持。老师持续使用，学校才有理由续费。博物馆则从一个本地故事开始，让观众进入故事、作选择、看后果。计划6万元做一个主题、三个场景、两轮审读。几类业务共用工具和研究，对每个客户需要的额外工作收费。这样一个项目就能帮着做下一个。但还要看工作结束以后，到底留下多少资金。

rehearsal.en:
For players, the plan is simple: sixty-eight yuan for the full game.
They buy it because it looks fun. They keep playing because they want to see what happens next.
If they enjoy that first voyage, we can offer new story packs at twenty-eight yuan.
So we have to make the first game good enough that people want another one.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指中间指南图片和¥12,000；用教师备课的具体处境来讲。
rehearsal.en:

Imagine bringing this game into a history lesson. The students have played a story about a new machine. Now the teacher wants them to talk about who it helped and who paid the price.
The teacher needs a guide, a clear lesson, and help getting started.
That's our education offer: twelve thousand yuan a year per institution, with guides, two training sessions, and an agreed amount of support.
If teachers keep using it, the school has a reason to renew.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指右侧展陈图与¥60,000，再看向观众。
rehearsal.en:
For a museum, we start with a local story.
Visitors step into that story, make a choice, and see what happens.
Our plan is sixty thousand yuan for one theme, three scenes, and two review rounds.
We can use the same game tools and research across these offers. We charge for the extra work each customer needs.
That way, each project helps us build the next one.
But we also need to know how much money is left when the work is done.

en: Growth must pay for the work behind it
zh: 增长，要能承担持续创作的成本。
en_script:
Let's follow the money.
Our first-year plan is based on two thousand paying players, ten institutions, and two museum projects.
That gives us three hundred and seventy-six thousand yuan in sales—the blue bar on the left.

We then pay for finding customers and doing the work.
The green bar shows what's left: about a hundred and sixty thousand yuan.
Building the game, creating the content, and running the business takes another two hundred and forty thousand.
So we finish the year almost eighty thousand yuan short.

That tells us what to work on.
We need cheaper ways to reach players. Teachers need materials they can use again. Museum projects need a clear limit on the work we agree to do.
A big order can look exciting. If it takes twice as long to finish, it can use up the money we need for the next story.
I want each sale to leave us enough to keep going.
That's why we'll start small and put more money in as the business proves itself.
zh_script: 顺着钱看一遍。第一年计划基于两千名付费玩家、十家机构、两个文博项目，收入37.6万元，就是左侧蓝柱。然后支付找客户和完成交付的成本，绿色剩下约16万元。游戏开发、内容制作和经营还需要24万元，因此一年下来差接近8万元。这告诉我们该改哪里：以更低成本触达玩家，让教师材料可以再用，让文博项目约定好工作量。大订单看起来令人兴奋，但如果要花两倍时间完成，就可能耗掉下个故事的钱。我希望每次销售都能留够继续做的资金，所以先小规模开始，随着业务跑通再增加投入。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指顶部客户数，再指左侧蓝柱；数字之间停半拍。
rehearsal.en:
Let's follow the money.
Our first-year plan is based on two thousand paying players, ten institutions, and two museum projects.
That gives us three hundred and seventy-six thousand yuan in sales—the blue bar on the left.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 手势顺着图往右移动。绿色约16万元，红色接近8万元，都与图上精确数字对应。
rehearsal.en:
We then pay for finding customers and doing the work.
The green bar shows what's left: about a hundred and sixty thousand yuan.
Building the game, creating the content, and running the business takes another two hundred and forty thousand.
So we finish the year almost eighty thousand yuan short.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 在红柱处停一秒，然后抬头解释自己会怎么做。
rehearsal.en:
That tells us what to work on.
We need cheaper ways to reach players. Teachers need materials they can use again. Museum projects need a clear limit on the work we agree to do.
A big order can look exciting. If it takes twice as long to finish, it can use up the money we need for the next story.
I want each sale to leave us enough to keep going.
That's why we'll start small and put more money in as the business proves itself.

zh: 让人愿意再来，让故事能够继续。
en_script:
Our total funding plan is three hundred and sixty thousand yuan.
Most goes into building the game and its stories. Some covers the time between doing the work and getting paid. We also keep a reserve.
We'll start with one hundred and twenty thousand yuan.

The steps on the right show how we'll use it.
First, make the game good enough that players finish a voyage and come back.
Then, work with paying schools and museums. Track how much time and money each project takes.
Once we know what works, put more money into new stories.
We'll be able to use what we've already built, instead of starting from scratch each time.

That's why the business matters. It gives us the time and money to keep telling these stories.
Civilization Voyage starts with Chinese civilization and takes us out into the world.
Along the way, we see how new tools change people's lives—and how people choose to use them.
We can build faster ships.
We still have to choose where they take us.
Let's choose a future worth arriving in.
Thank you.
zh_script: 总资金计划36万元，大部分用于开发游戏和故事，一部分用于做完到回款之间的周转，同时保留储备。先投入12万元。右侧是使用顺序：先把游戏做到让玩家玩完一段航程还愿意回来；再与付费学校和博物馆合作，记录每个项目花多少时间和钱；清楚什么方式有效以后，再投入新故事。已经做好的内容可以接着用，无须每次从头开始。商业之所以重要，是因为它给我们时间和资金，把故事继续讲下去。文明航程从中华文明出发，带我们走向世界，看到新工具如何改变人的生活，也看到人们如何选择使用它。我们可以造出更快的船，驶向何方仍由我们选择。愿我们驶向的未来值得抵达。谢谢。
